set.body: Found in the UI-M4 review (2026-09-18). PreflightFinding has no key parameter and PreflightError.NotReady holds Vector[PreflightFinding] (plan/Preflight.scala), so M4's diagnostics project preflight errors to Diagnostic[Any] and a consumer must cast before calling StudySources[K].link. Make PreflightError covariant in the study key (PreflightError[+K]) with typed findings, keep recording findings keyless, and update M4's Diagnose instances and tests so preflight diagnostics are Diagnostic[K].
set.title: Give PreflightError a key type so its findings project to Diagnostic[K]
